lines: - Quinn: "Let all the System see that the Zariman is defended."
- Quinn: "Shine that light of yours over here for a second."
- Quinn: "Come on. Plenty need seeing to."
- Quinn: "We need all the hands we can get."

- Quinn: "Glad you decided to stick around. This place, the Chrysalith, was meant to be a sanctuary. Now it's a war room. We're fending off Grineer raiders, Corpus salvage hunters, and of course, the Void Angels. Taking our home back is going to be a long hard fight. I mean to make use of your exceptional talents wherever I can. Come and see me whenever you are ready for a bounty assignment."

- Quinn: "Every ship needs a figurehead. Executor Ballas presented us with sweet Gyra on the day of our departure. She spoke with her movement. Her dancing was meant to bring joy, but when we entered the Void... such madness, and one so gentle. The way you move now reminds me of her."
- Quinn: "This place is one bad decision away from heading straight back into hell."
- Quinn: "While we sit here straddling the Rift, all possibilities are real."
- Quinn: "The Grineer keep throwing troops at the Zariman. Whatever the Worm's is finding here, she wants more of it."
- Quinn: "Parvos Granum wants this ship for himself. We need to show him she's taken."
- Quinn: "Please remember that your presence is enough to revive us. We won't ever leave you drained."
- Quinn: "The song tears at us slowly like hooks dragging through flesh. Every time you silence one of them, it gets a little easier."
- Quinn: "This ship is now a fortress on the threshold, and we are her defenders."
- Quinn: "Ready to deploy you wherever you can do the most good."
- Quinn: "The Albrecht Membrane is shot to hell. We're getting Void Flood alerts almost constantly."
- Quinn: "Void Cascades on multiple decks. We've got our work cut out for us."
- Quinn: "Void Angels still trying to feed on the Reliquary Drive. How do we keep them out?"
- Quinn: "We should be doing more to recognize your work."
- Quinn: "Let's go forward in mutual trust."
- Quinn: "Our stores aren't what they were, but this may be useful."
- Quinn: "No point in saving this for Tau."
- Quinn: "Here's what we got. Such as it is."
- Quinn: "Thank you for everything you've done."
- Quinn: "Shoulder to shoulder or back to back. The fight goes on."
- Quinn: "All four of us owe you a lot."
- Quinn: "Go and visit Hell upon them."
- Quinn: "Remind them who the Zariman belongs to."
- Quinn: "Save your strength for when it's needed."
- Quinn: "Okay, I'll call on some of the others."
- Quinn: "Clear skies and steady rails to you."
- Quinn: "One hand for yourself, and one for the ship."

- Quinn: "Long before the Orokin, people believe in other gods. Invisible, often incomprehensible. But worthy of devotion because they invested life with meaning beyond a mortal lifespan. You and I? Walking godless lands, my friend. We skirt the borders of a tear with no limit to its depth. And yet, I find I need no gods to bring meaning to my existence. You have done that. And if there were any gods to thank, I would thank them for you."
- Quinn: "The tide is turning. I can feel it. We will reclaim this place."
- Quinn: "We've both been gifted a second chance. I perceive two Void silhouettes within you. Do you wonder which is the real one?"
- Quinn: "All my days, our Orokin overlords towered over us, and I woke to find their intended saviours had cut them down like overgrown weeds."
- Quinn: "I share this eternity with every person I ever sentenced to be glassed. I can only hope their's is a happier one."
- Quinn: "There are debts other than ours still to be paid. This is a place where great and terrible bargains were struck."
- Quinn: "When the time comes to confront what waits beyond, we will stand with you just as you stood with us."
- Quinn: "We are not all together damned, we loyal few."
- Quinn: "You will be tempted to look for familiar faces among the angels. I beg you not to give into it."
- Quinn: "Look at us. A living dead man talking to a Void-born paradox. This universe is sure full of wonders."
- Quinn: "I lost her twice. First to her gallant suitor, then to her father's ghost. By now, she is surely dust with the rest of them. At least I can still listen to her voice."
- Quinn: "There's my sturdy crewmate. Still ready to what needs doing even after doing so much."
- Quinn: "Come old friend, let's get to it."
- Quinn: "The struggle goes on and we'll be the ones to finish it."
This section is transcluded from Void Cascade/Quotes. To change it, please edit the transcluded page.

- Quinn: "The Corpus have triggered the deployment of Thrax-possessed Exolizers. Deployed altogether, they will cause an instant Void Cascade. I can stagger their deployment; give you time to purge them, so they can cleanse the ship instead of corrupting it."
- Quinn: "Grineer meddling with the Reliquary Drive has triggered a Void Cascade. Purge our Exolizers and keep them purged, so they can stop the cascade getting out of hand."
- Quinn: "That possessed Exolizer is spitting out contamination. Use your Void power to purge it!"
- Quinn: "Hoh, that got their attention! Enemy forces moving to your location!
- Quinn: "Any nearby attackers will degrade the Exolizer's performance. Clear them out to get the system working full-steam."
- Quinn: "If you can kill the Grineer close to the Exolizer, it'll pull the Void contamination right off of them."
- Quinn: "Now the Exolizer's purged. Any casualties you inflict within its field will bring the contamination level down."
- Quinn: "The enemy has triggered the release of a possessed Exolizer! Purge it before pumps out even more Void Contamination!"
- Quinn: "Possessed Exolizer located. Purge it and make it work for us!"
- Quinn: "Marking a possessed Exolizer. Deal with it while you still can!"
- Quinn: "That Exolizer is working for us now."
- Quinn: "A Void Manifestation is possessing an Exolizer. Stop it before it feeds the cascade."
- Quinn: "Keep those manifestations away from the Exolizers!"
- Quinn: "Those Void nightmares are hell-bent on one thing: manifesting more nightmares."
- Quinn: "Exolizer supressed, purge it before it makes the contamination worse!"
- Quinn: "We just lost an Exolizer to possession. Get it back!"
- Quinn: "We're down an Exolizer, working on back-ups."
- Quinn: "Contamination levels going in the wrong direction!"
- Quinn: "This cascade is growing out of control!"
- Quinn: "Cascade is approaching critical level! Your time is running out!"
- Quinn: "Void Cascade is nearing the tipping point! You're about to face irreversible contamination!"
- Quinn: "The Void Cascade has surpassed the tipping point! It's lethal now! Leave the area while you still can!"
- Quinn: "Hm, our enemy has abandoned valuable supplies. This is yours now."
- Quinn: "Ah, the Void has manifested something other than a nightmare."
- Quinn: "Our enemy's folly is your gain."
- Quinn: "See what you make of this."
- Quinn: "The Void Cascade just hit a new level of intensity. Be careful, we have no idea what it could manifest."
- Quinn: "Contamination just spiked! Keep your wits about you!"
- Quinn: "Readings are off the charts, I don't know what sort of nightmares you might encounter."
- Quinn: "Void Contamination critical! Do these invaders have any idea what demons they have invoked upon us all?"
- Quinn: "Your cleared to self-extract, when you're ready."
- Quinn: "I've opened an extraction route. Your choice when to use it."
- Quinn: "Extract yourself when you need to."
- Quinn: "Destabilizing the Zariman is a foolhardy strategy. The Void has already started to degrade our enemies' judgement. You did well to stop them."
- Quinn: "You did everything you could. I've secured enough cleansed Exolizers to keep the cascade at bay for now."
- Quinn: "Good work, you did all you could out there."
- Quinn: "Kid?! Tenno?! Say something! Can you hear me?! KID?!"
- Quinn: "Hey! Talk to me! Oh no..."
- Quinn: "Hey! Kid! You can't give up on me now! Kid?!"
